comments.body:
Ship Cook Shirt, released 10/25 in the Halloween Mystery Bottle. Stats:

+1 Cooking
Unisex, 5k fame to equip

Fun fact: Originally available to Japanese players who purchased the "10th Anniversary Deluxe BOX Amazon Early Booking Special Offer" edition of UWO. Also the only +1 cooking body equip in the entire game. Granted, Mysterious Spices give +5, but I'm sure this will be useful to some people out there.

Images/Stats: eririndol.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-287.html
